main.description: List changelog entries for a specific subject record, ordered newest first.

subject.description: AT-URI of the subject record to list changelogs for.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return in one page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response, to resume after the last returned record.

entries.description: The page of changelog entry records returned.

uri.description: AT-URI of this changelog entry record.

cid.description: CID of this changelog entry record at this revision.
